_about: All values of the learning model. Change the values here, not in the code.

mastery._about: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing. p is the chance that the player knows the skill.
mastery._rulesAbout: A skill becomes mastered only when p >= mastered, after at least minAnswers answers, with at least minTopCorrect correct answers at the highest level, and with at most recentMistakes wrong answers in the last recentAnswers answers (fewer mistakes when there are fewer answers). It stays mastered until p falls below almost. Near mastery (p >= almost), the problems use the highest level.

rating._about: Elo-style ratings for the player (one for each skill) and for each problem item (skill and level).

review._about: Spaced review with Leitner boxes. Box n waits intervalsDays[n - 1] days.

practice._about: Mixed practice: the share of problems from other learned skills.
practice._parentShareAbout: The share of problems from the parent editor, for a skill that has parent questions.

feedback._about: Feedback after mistakes on one problem: first a hint, then a worked example, then a similar problem.

subject._about: The adaptive subject exam. It starts easy and gets harder until the player makes a few mistakes.

era1._about: The pass mark comes from a simulation: at passAbility, about half of the players pass. Run the test "the Era 1 pass mark comes from the simulation" after a change, and copy the new value to pass.

placement._about: The placement exam starts near the grade of the player: the base rating of the grade plus startOffset. It never lowers a mastered skill.
